the structure determination of poorly diffractive membrane-protein crystals is feasible using a combination of heavy-atom site search, multi-crystal averaging and phase combination.

the structure determination of poorly diffractive membrane proteins can be achieved using molecular replacement, even when the model is not closely related to the target protein, as long as the search model has been refined to a high resolution and the native data sets are not isomorphous.
